name: Claude usage
author: Tim
description: Claude plan usage and every Claude Code session running on this machine: the session or weekly % in the bar, the limits and the sessions in a panel, and notifications when a session needs you.

barWidget.description: The session or weekly limit used, with the plan's limits and the running Claude Code sessions in the panel.

schema.label: Show the % in the bar
schema.description: The 5-hour session limit used, or the weekly one on a plan without a session limit. Off leaves the icon alone.

schema.label: Notify when a session needs you
schema.description: A notification when a session blocks on a permission prompt or a question, or stalls.

schema.label: Notify when a long turn finishes
schema.description: A notification when a turn of 2 minutes or more ends.

schema.label: Stalled after (minutes)
schema.description: A busy session counts as Stalled once nothing has been written to its transcript for this long.
